edges_by_subject.map: function(doc){if(!doc||!doc._id||doc._id.indexOf('_design/')===0)return;if(doc.dtype!=='relation')return;var d=(doc.data&&typeof doc.data==='object')?doc.data:doc;function rid(x){if(typeof x==='string')return x;if(x&&typeof x==='object')return x.id||x.entity_id||x.document_id||x.external_id||null;return null;}function endpoints(x){if(Object.prototype.toString.call(x)==='[object Array]')return x;return [x];}var s=rid(d.subject||d.source);var os=endpoints(d.object!==undefined?d.object:d.target);if(!s)return;for(var i=0;i<os.length;i++){var o=rid(os[i]);if(o)emit([s,d.predicate||d.relation_type||'related-to',o],doc._id);}}
